title: Self-worth to human solidarity integration
changes: Added a doctrine distinguishing self-hatred as one possible pathway from a universal cause of hatred.
Added a lifespan curriculum for children, adolescents, adults and older adults.
Added a deterministic language guard for self-directed shame/devaluation and group dehumanization.
Added unit tests for the guard.
Integrated the principle with existing peace, dignity, agency, boundary and non-ownership governance.
truth_boundary: Repository implementation is verified by source inspection; public deployment, full chat integration and measured worldwide outcomes are not claimed until independently verified.
safety: No autonomous external action, payment, user-data export or diagnosis was performed.
